panels.title: Champion
panels.description: Modellversion in Produktion (meta.model_version, gespiegelt aus der Registry in Garage durch ml-train registry sync bzw. jeden Lauf von ml-predict). Variante und Zeitpunkt des Trainings.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT v.variant || ' · ' || to_char(v.created AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin', 'DD.MM.YY HH24:MI') AS "Champion"
  FROM meta.model_version v
 WHERE v.role = 'champion' ORDER BY v.created DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Trainiert vor
panels.description: Alter der jüngsten registrierten Modellversion (ml-train fit).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT extract(epoch FROM now() - max(created)) / 86400 AS "Tage"
  FROM meta.model_version

panels.title: Prognose vor
panels.description: Jüngster Ausgabezeitpunkt in fcst.prediction. ml-predict rechnet stündlich.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT extract(epoch FROM now() - max(issue_time)) / 3600 AS "Stunden"
  FROM fcst.prediction

panels.title: Modellversionen
panels.description: Alle Versionen der Registry, aktive zuerst. Dauer = reines Training bzw. der zugehörige Backtest (alle Faltungen). Tage = Ausgabetage des Trainings. MAE D+1 aus dem Backtest der Version (Median gegen Ist).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT v.variant AS "Variante", CASE v.role WHEN 'champion' THEN 'Champion' WHEN 'challenger' THEN 'Challenger' WHEN 'baseline' THEN 'Baseline' WHEN 'previous' THEN 'Vorgänger' ELSE 'ausgemustert' END AS "Rolle",
       to_char(v.created AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin', 'DD.MM.YY HH24:MI') AS "Trainiert",
       v.train_seconds AS "Training", v.backtest_seconds AS "Backtest",
       v.train_rows AS "Zeilen",
       to_char(v.train_from, 'DD.MM.YY') || ' – ' || to_char(v.train_to, 'DD.MM.YY') AS "Tage",
       (SELECT m.mae FROM meta.model_metric m WHERE m.version = v.version AND m.target = 'load_actual' AND m.lead_day = 1) AS "MAE Last D+1",
       (SELECT m.mae FROM meta.model_metric m WHERE m.version = v.version AND m.target = 'da_price_de_lu' AND m.lead_day = 1) AS "MAE Preis D+1",
       v.git_commit AS "Commit", v.version AS "Version"
  FROM meta.model_version v
 ORDER BY CASE v.role WHEN 'champion' THEN 0 WHEN 'challenger' THEN 1 WHEN 'baseline' THEN 2 WHEN 'previous' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END, v.created DESC LIMIT 12

panels.title: Prognosefehler Last D+1 (Tagesmittel)
panels.description: Tagesmittel des Fehlers der Medianprognose (P50) für den Folgetag (D+1) aus der Ausgabe um 08 UTC (wie im Backtest) gegen den Ist-Wert, je Modellversion aus fcst.prediction_error. RMSE gestrichelt. Ohne Gesamtsumme, da sich Fehler verschiedener Modelle nicht addieren. ENTSO-E Day-Ahead als Vergleich. Gepunktet auf der rechten Achse: relativer Fehler in Prozent, gerechnet als Tages-MAE geteilt durch den mittleren Betrag des Ist-Last am selben Tag (WAPE = Σ|Prognose − Ist| / Σ|Ist|), gekappt bei 100 %. Für ENTSO-E Day-Ahead genauso berechnet.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time_bucket('1 day', e.valid_time, 'Europe/Berlin') AS time,
       v.variant || ' ' || to_char(v.created AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin', 'DD.MM. HH24:MI') || ' · ' || CASE v.role WHEN 'champion' THEN 'Champion' WHEN 'challenger' THEN 'Challenger' WHEN 'baseline' THEN 'Baseline' WHEN 'previous' THEN 'Vorgänger' ELSE 'ausgemustert' END || ' MAE' AS metric, avg(abs(e.err)) AS value
  FROM fcst.prediction_error e JOIN meta.model_version v ON v.version = e.model_version
 WHERE e.target = 'load_actual' AND e.lead_day = 1 AND e.err IS NOT NULL
   AND extract(hour FROM e.issue_time AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') = 8
   AND $__timeFilter(e.valid_time)
 GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT time_bucket('1 day', e.valid_time, 'Europe/Berlin') AS time,
       v.variant || ' ' || to_char(v.created AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin', 'DD.MM. HH24:MI') || ' · ' || CASE v.role WHEN 'champion' THEN 'Champion' WHEN 'challenger' THEN 'Challenger' WHEN 'baseline' THEN 'Baseline' WHEN 'previous' THEN 'Vorgänger' ELSE 'ausgemustert' END || ' RMSE' AS metric, sqrt(avg(e.err ^ 2)) AS value
  FROM fcst.prediction_error e JOIN meta.model_version v ON v.version = e.model_version
 WHERE e.target = 'load_actual' AND e.lead_day = 1 AND e.err IS NOT NULL
   AND extract(hour FROM e.issue_time AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') = 8
   AND $__timeFilter(e.valid_time)
 GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

WITH h AS (
  SELECT time_bucket('1 hour', ts) AS ts, code, avg(value) AS value
    FROM energy.value_best WHERE code IN ('load_actual', 'load_da_forecast') AND $__timeFilter(ts)
   GROUP BY 1, 2)
SELECT time_bucket('1 day', a.ts, 'Europe/Berlin') AS time, 'ENTSO-E Day-Ahead MAE' AS metric,
       avg(abs(f.value - a.value)) AS value
  FROM h a JOIN h f ON f.ts = a.ts AND f.code = 'load_da_forecast'
 WHERE a.code = 'load_actual'
 GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT time_bucket('1 day', e.valid_time, 'Europe/Berlin') AS time,
       v.variant || ' ' || to_char(v.created AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin', 'DD.MM. HH24:MI') || ' · ' || CASE v.role WHEN 'champion' THEN 'Champion' WHEN 'challenger' THEN 'Challenger' WHEN 'baseline' THEN 'Baseline' WHEN 'previous' THEN 'Vorgänger' ELSE 'ausgemustert' END || ' Fehler %' AS metric,
       least(100 * sum(abs(e.err)) / nullif(sum(abs(e.actual)), 0), 100) AS value
  FROM fcst.prediction_error e JOIN meta.model_version v ON v.version = e.model_version
 WHERE e.target = 'load_actual' AND e.lead_day = 1 AND e.err IS NOT NULL
   AND extract(hour FROM e.issue_time AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') = 8
   AND $__timeFilter(e.valid_time)
 GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

WITH h AS (
  SELECT time_bucket('1 hour', ts) AS ts, code, avg(value) AS value
    FROM energy.value_best WHERE code IN ('load_actual', 'load_da_forecast') AND $__timeFilter(ts)
   GROUP BY 1, 2)
SELECT time_bucket('1 day', a.ts, 'Europe/Berlin') AS time, 'ENTSO-E Day-Ahead Fehler %' AS metric,
       least(100 * sum(abs(f.value - a.value)) / nullif(sum(abs(a.value)), 0), 100) AS value
  FROM h a JOIN h f ON f.ts = a.ts AND f.code = 'load_da_forecast'
 WHERE a.code = 'load_actual'
 GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Prognosefehler Preis D+1 (Tagesmittel)
panels.description: Tagesmittel des Fehlers der Medianprognose (P50) für den Folgetag (D+1) aus der Ausgabe um 08 UTC (wie im Backtest) gegen den Ist-Wert, je Modellversion aus fcst.prediction_error. RMSE gestrichelt. Ohne Gesamtsumme, da sich Fehler verschiedener Modelle nicht addieren. Gepunktet auf der rechten Achse: relativer Fehler in Prozent, gerechnet als Tages-MAE geteilt durch den mittleren Betrag des Ist-Preises am selben Tag (WAPE = Σ|Prognose − Ist| / Σ|Ist|), gekappt bei 100 %. Bewusst kein stundenweiser MAPE: Preise liegen oft nahe 0 € oder sind negativ, einzelne Stunden würden den Mittelwert sonst sprengen. An Tagen mit durchweg niedrigen Preisen fällt die Prozentzahl trotzdem hoch aus, daher die Kappung bei 100 %.

 WHERE e.target = 'da_price_de_lu' AND e.lead_day = 1 AND e.err IS NOT NULL

   AND $__timeFilter(e.valid_time)
 GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

HH24:MI') || ' · ' || CASE v.role WHEN 'champion' THEN 'Champion' WHEN 'challenger' THEN 'Challenger' WHEN 'baseline' THEN 'Baseline' WHEN 'previous' THEN 'Vorgänger' ELSE 'ausgemustert' END || ' RMSE' AS metric, sqrt(avg(e.err ^ 2)) AS value
  FROM fcst.prediction_error e JOIN meta.model_version v ON v.version = e.model_version

SELECT time_bucket('1 day', e.valid_time, 'Europe/Berlin') AS time,
       v.variant || ' ' || to_char(v.created AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin', 'DD.MM. HH24:MI') || ' · ' || CASE v.role WHEN 'champion' THEN 'Champion' WHEN 'challenger' THEN 'Challenger' WHEN 'baseline' THEN 'Baseline' WHEN 'previous' THEN 'Vorgänger' ELSE 'ausgemustert' END || ' Fehler %' AS metric,

panels.title: Lastprognose: eigene Modelle gegen ÜNB (Vortag 10 Uhr, gestern bis Tagesende)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ts AS time, code AS metric, value
  FROM energy.value_best
 WHERE code IN ('load_actual', 'load_da_forecast') AND $__timeFilter(ts)
 ORDER BY 1

-- Je Liefertag die eigene Prognose vom Vortag 10:00 Ortszeit, zeitgleich mit der
-- Day-Ahead-Lastprognose der ÜNB (bis 10:00 am Vortag, VO 543/2013 Art. 6.1 b)
SELECT p.valid_time AS time,
       v.config || ' ' || v.variant || ' · ' || CASE v.role WHEN 'champion' THEN 'Champion' ELSE 'Challenger' END AS metric, p.value
  FROM fcst.prediction p JOIN meta.model_version v ON v.version = p.model_version
 WHERE p.target = 'load_actual' AND p.quantile = 0.5 AND v.role IN ('champion', 'challenger')
   AND extract(hour FROM p.issue_time AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin') = 10
   AND (p.valid_time AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin')::date
         - (p.issue_time AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin')::date = 1
   AND $__timeFilter(p.valid_time)
 ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Fairer Vergleich zum selben Zeitpunkt: Für jeden Liefertag zeigt die Grafik die Medianprognose (P50) unserer aktiven Modelle (Champion und Challenger je Linie), die am Vortag um 10:00 Ortszeit gerechnet wurde. Bis dahin veröffentlichen die Übertragungsnetzbetreiber ihre Day-Ahead-Lastprognose (gestrichelt). Zeitbereich wie im Preis-Panel: gestern und heute, ab 12 Uhr auch morgen.

  FROM energy.value_best

-- Je Liefertag die eigene Prognose vom Vortag 10:00 Ortszeit, zeitgleich mit der
-- Day-Ahead-Lastprognose der ÜNB (bis 10:00 am Vortag, VO 543/2013 Art. 6.1 b)
SELECT p.valid_time AS time,

panels.description: Medianprognose (P50) unserer aktiven Modelle für jeden Liefertag, gerechnet am Vortag um 10:00 Ortszeit (zeitgleich mit der ÜNB-Lastprognose und vor Gebotsschluss der Day-Ahead-Auktion um 12 Uhr), gegen den Auktionspreis DE-LU. Die ÜNB veröffentlichen keine Preisprognose. Zeitbereich wie im Preis-Panel.

panels.title: Champion und Challenger im Backtest (MAE)
panels.description: MAE der Medianprognose je Vorlauftag aus dem Backtest der aktiven Versionen (meta.model_metric). Gesamt und RMSE über alle Vorlauftage. P10–P90 = Anteil der Ist-Werte im 80-%-Band (Soll 80 %). Last in MW, Preis in €/MWh.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT CASE v.role WHEN 'champion' THEN 'Champion' WHEN 'challenger' THEN 'Challenger' WHEN 'baseline' THEN 'Baseline' WHEN 'previous' THEN 'Vorgänger' ELSE 'ausgemustert' END || ' · ' || v.variant || ' ' || to_char(v.created AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin', 'DD.MM.') AS "Version", CASE m.target WHEN 'load_actual' THEN 'Last MW' WHEN 'da_price_de_lu' THEN 'Preis €/MWh' END AS "Ziel",
       avg(m.mae) FILTER (WHERE m.lead_day = 1) AS "D+1",
       avg(m.mae) FILTER (WHERE m.lead_day = 2) AS "D+2",
       avg(m.mae) FILTER (WHERE m.lead_day = 7) AS "D+7",
       avg(m.mae) FILTER (WHERE m.lead_day = 0) AS "Gesamt",
       avg(m.rmse) FILTER (WHERE m.lead_day = 0) AS "RMSE",
       avg(m.coverage80) FILTER (WHERE m.lead_day = 0) AS "P10–P90"
  FROM meta.model_metric m JOIN meta.model_version v USING (version)
 WHERE v.role <> 'retired' AND m.target IN ('load_actual', 'da_price_de_lu')
 GROUP BY v.version, v.variant, v.created, v.role, m.target
 ORDER BY m.target DESC, CASE v.role WHEN 'champion' THEN 0 WHEN 'challenger' THEN 1 WHEN 'baseline' THEN 2 WHEN 'previous' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END, v.created DESC

panels.title: Prognosefehler im Betrieb, letzte 14 Tage (MAE)
panels.description: Wie der Backtest, aber aus den gespeicherten Live-Prognosen (fcst.prediction) der letzten 14 Liefertage gegen die Ist-Werte, Ausgabe um 08 UTC. Bias = mittlere Abweichung (positiv: Prognose zu hoch).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT CASE v.role WHEN 'champion' THEN 'Champion' WHEN 'challenger' THEN 'Challenger' WHEN 'baseline' THEN 'Baseline' WHEN 'previous' THEN 'Vorgänger' ELSE 'ausgemustert' END || ' · ' || v.variant || ' ' || to_char(v.created AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin', 'DD.MM.') AS "Version", CASE e.target WHEN 'load_actual' THEN 'Last MW' WHEN 'da_price_de_lu' THEN 'Preis €/MWh' END AS "Ziel",
       avg(abs(e.err)) FILTER (WHERE e.lead_day = 1) AS "D+1",
       avg(abs(e.err)) FILTER (WHERE e.lead_day = 2) AS "D+2",
       avg(abs(e.err)) FILTER (WHERE e.lead_day = 7) AS "D+7",
       avg(e.err) AS "Bias", count(*) AS "Werte"
  FROM fcst.prediction_error e JOIN meta.model_version v ON v.version = e.model_version
 WHERE e.valid_time >= now() - interval '14 days' AND e.err IS NOT NULL
   AND extract(hour FROM e.issue_time AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') = 8
   AND e.target IN ('load_actual', 'da_price_de_lu')
 GROUP BY v.version, v.variant, v.created, v.role, e.target
 ORDER BY e.target DESC, CASE v.role WHEN 'champion' THEN 0 WHEN 'challenger' THEN 1 WHEN 'baseline' THEN 2 WHEN 'previous' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END, v.created DESC

panels.title: Registry-Verlauf
panels.description: Registrierungen und Rollenwechsel (meta.model_event).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT to_char(at AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin', 'DD.MM.YY HH24:MI') AS "Zeit",
       CASE action WHEN 'champion' THEN 'Champion' WHEN 'challenger' THEN 'Challenger' WHEN 'baseline' THEN 'Baseline' ELSE action END AS "Aktion",
       split_part(version, '-', 2) || ' ' || to_char(to_timestamp(split_part(version, '-', 3), 'YYYYMMDDHH24MI'), 'DD.MM.') AS "Version", note AS "Notiz"
  FROM meta.model_event ORDER BY at DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: Energiedaten je Quelle

targets.rawSql:
WITH ds AS (
  SELECT source_id, dataset, min(chunk_start) AS erster
    FROM meta.energy_fetch GROUP BY 1, 2)
SELECT s.code AS "Quelle",
       count(DISTINCT f.dataset) AS "Sätze",
       to_char((SELECT max(erster) FROM ds WHERE ds.source_id = s.source_id), 'DD.MM.YY') AS "Alle ab",
       to_char(min(f.chunk_start), 'DD.MM.YY') AS "Weitester ab",
       to_char(max(f.chunk_end), 'DD.MM.YY') AS "Bis",
       sum(f.n_values) AS "Werte",
       to_char(max(f.fetched_at) AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin', 'DD.MM. HH24:MI') AS "Letzter Abruf"
  FROM meta.energy_fetch f JOIN meta.source s USING (source_id)
 GROUP BY s.source_id, s.code ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Aus meta.energy_fetch. Sätze = Datensätze der Quelle. Der Backfill arbeitet sich Datensatz für Datensatz zurück: „Alle ab“ ist der Stand des langsamsten, „Weitester ab“ der des schnellsten. Bis = neuester geladener Zeitpunkt.

panels.title: Backfill seit 2015

targets.rawSql:
WITH ds AS (
  SELECT source_id, dataset, min(chunk_start) AS erster
    FROM meta.energy_fetch GROUP BY 1, 2),
p AS (
  SELECT s.code,
         least(100, round((100 * avg(extract(epoch FROM now() - ds.erster)
                          / extract(epoch FROM now() - timestamptz '2015-01-01')))::numeric, 1)) AS pct
    FROM ds JOIN meta.source s USING (source_id)
   GROUP BY 1)
SELECT code || '  ' || replace(to_char(pct, 'FM990.0'), '.', ',') || ' %' AS "Quelle",
       pct AS "Fortschritt"
  FROM p ORDER BY code

panels.description: Mittel über alle Datensätze einer Quelle: Anteil der Zeitspanne 2015 bis heute, die schon geladen ist.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time_bucket('1 hour', f.fetched_at) AS time, s.code AS metric, sum(f.n_values) AS value
  FROM meta.energy_fetch f JOIN meta.source s USING (source_id)
 WHERE $__timeFilter(f.fetched_at)
 GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT time_bucket('1 hour', fetched_at) AS time, 'Gesamt' AS metric, sum(n_values) AS value
  FROM meta.energy_fetch
 WHERE $__timeFilter(fetched_at)
 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ts AS time, code AS metric, value
  FROM energy.value_best

panels.description: Zeigt immer gestern und heute komplett, unabhängig vom Dashboard-Zeitbereich; ab 12 Uhr zusätzlich morgen (Day-Ahead-Auktion gegen 12 Uhr, Veröffentlichung ab ca. 13 Uhr). Gestrichelt die Day-Ahead-Lastprognose der Übertragungsnetzbetreiber.

panels.title: Neuester verarbeiteter Lauf

targets.rawSql:
SELECT to_char(max(run_time) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'DD.MM.YYYY HH24:MI "UTC"') AS "Lauf"
  FROM meta.nwp_feature_run

panels.description: Aus meta.nwp_feature_run (wx-process). Bronze-Downloads selbst stehen nur im Log von ingest-gfs.

targets.rawSql: SELECT extract(epoch FROM now() - max(run_time)) / 3600 AS "Stunden" FROM meta.nwp_feature_run

SELECT to_char(run_time AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'DD.MM.YYYY HH24:MI "UTC"') AS "Lauf",
       clustering_version AS "Clusterung", features_version AS "Features",
       n_values AS "Werte", processed_at AS "Verarbeitet"
  FROM meta.nwp_feature_run
 ORDER BY run_time DESC LIMIT 12

panels.title: GFS-Downloads: laufende Jobs
panels.description: Neu = neu geladene Läufe, Da = schon vorhanden, Unv. = unvollständig, Fehler = fehlgeschlagene Schritte. Zeitraum und Zuletzt in UTC, Start und Fertig ca. lokal.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT job_id AS "Job",
       CASE mode WHEN 'live' THEN 'Live' ELSE 'Backfill' END AS "Art",
       to_char(range_start AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'DD.MM.YY HH24"Z"') || ' – ' ||
         to_char(range_end AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'DD.MM.YY HH24"Z"') AS "Zeitraum",
       array_to_string(run_hours, '/') || 'Z' AS "Läufe",
       round(100.0 * (n_complete + n_incomplete) / nullif(n_runs, 0), 1) AS "Fortschritt",
       (n_complete + n_incomplete) || '/' || n_runs AS "Bearbeitet",
       n_complete - n_skipped AS "Neu",
       n_skipped AS "Da",
       n_incomplete AS "Unv.",
       n_failed_steps AS "Fehler",
       bytes_stored AS "Bronze",
       to_char(last_run AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'DD.MM.YY HH24"Z"') AS "Zuletzt",
       to_char(started_at AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin', 'DD.MM. HH24:MI') AS "Start",
       CASE WHEN mode = 'backfill' AND n_complete + n_incomplete > n_skipped
            THEN to_char((now() + (now() - started_at) * (n_runs - n_complete - n_incomplete)
                          / (n_complete + n_incomplete - n_skipped)) AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin',
                         'DD.MM. HH24:MI') END AS "Fertig ca.",
       CASE WHEN updated_at < now() - interval '30 minutes' THEN 'hängt?' ELSE 'läuft' END AS "Status"
  FROM meta.backfill_job
 WHERE status = 'running'
 ORDER BY started_at DESC

panels.title: GFS-Downloads: laufende und anstehende Läufe
panels.description: Oben die Live-Läufe (ingest-gfs, eigener Dienst mit eigener Quelle NOMADS, unabhängig vom Backfill): „NOAA ab hh:mm“ = Lauf noch nicht veröffentlicht, frühestens ab dieser lokalen Zeit; „wartet (NOAA)“ = teilweise veröffentlicht. Darunter laufende Backfill-Läufe und die nächsten der Warteschlange. Lauf in UTC, Start lokal.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT CASE j.mode WHEN 'live' THEN 'Live' ELSE 'Backfill' END AS "Art",
       CASE WHEN r.status = 'running' THEN 'läuft'
            WHEN j.mode = 'live' AND r.steps_done = 0
              THEN 'NOAA ab ' || to_char((r.run_time + interval '3 hours 30 minutes')
                                         AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin', 'HH24:MI')
            WHEN j.mode = 'live' THEN 'wartet (NOAA)'
            ELSE 'wartet' END AS "Status",
       r.queue_pos AS "Pos",
       to_char(r.run_time AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'DD.MM.YYYY HH24"Z"') AS "Lauf",
       CASE WHEN r.status = 'running'
            THEN round(100.0 * r.steps_done / nullif(r.n_steps, 0), 1) END AS "Fortschritt",
       CASE WHEN r.status = 'running' THEN r.steps_done || '/' || r.n_steps END AS "Schritte",
       CASE WHEN r.status = 'running' THEN r.bytes_stored END AS "Bronze",
       to_char(r.started_at AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin', 'DD.MM. HH24:MI') AS "Start"
  FROM meta.backfill_run r JOIN meta.backfill_job j USING (job_id)
 WHERE j.status = 'running' AND r.status IN ('running', 'queued')
 ORDER BY (j.mode = 'live') DESC, (r.status = 'running') DESC, r.queue_pos
 LIMIT 50

panels.title: GFS-Downloads: zuletzt abgeschlossene Läufe
panels.description: Die letzten 50 abgeschlossenen Läufe aller Jobs, neueste oben. Neu = neu geladene Schritte; Lauf in UTC, Fertig in lokaler Zeit. übergeben = vom nächsten Live-Job geladen.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT to_char(r.run_time AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'DD.MM.YYYY HH24"Z"') AS "Lauf",
       CASE WHEN r.status = 'complete' AND r.steps_stored = 0 THEN 'schon da'
                     ELSE CASE r.status WHEN 'complete' THEN 'geladen' WHEN 'skipped' THEN 'schon da'
                     WHEN 'incomplete' THEN 'unvollst.' WHEN 'handed_over' THEN 'übergeben' ELSE 'abgebr.' END END AS "Ergebnis",
       r.steps_stored AS "Neu",
       r.steps_failed AS "Fehler",
       r.bytes_stored AS "Bronze",
       to_char(r.finished_at - r.started_at, 'HH24:MI:SS') AS "Dauer",
       to_char(r.finished_at AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin', 'DD.MM. HH24:MI') AS "Fertig",
       CASE j.mode WHEN 'live' THEN 'Live' ELSE 'Backfill' END AS "Art"
  FROM meta.backfill_run r JOIN meta.backfill_job j USING (job_id)
 WHERE r.finished_at IS NOT NULL
 ORDER BY r.finished_at DESC
 LIMIT 50

panels.title: GFS-Downloads: letzte 10 abgeschlossene Jobs
panels.description: Neu = neu geladene Läufe, Da = schon vorhanden, Unv. = unvollständig, Überg. = offene Läufe eines beendeten Live-Jobs, die der nächste Job lädt (meist der jüngste, bei NOAA noch nicht veröffentlichte; zählen nicht zum Fortschritt), Fehler = fehlgeschlagene Schritte, abgebr. = abgebrochen. Dauer in Stunden:Minuten. Fehlermeldungen stehen in meta.backfill_job.error.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT job_id AS "Job",
       CASE mode WHEN 'live' THEN 'Live' ELSE 'Backfill' END AS "Art",
       to_char(range_start AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'DD.MM.YY HH24"Z"') || ' – ' ||
         to_char(range_end AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'DD.MM.YY HH24"Z"') AS "Zeitraum",
       array_to_string(run_hours, '/') || 'Z' AS "Läufe",
       round(100.0 * (n_complete + n_incomplete) / nullif(n_runs - h.n, 0), 1) AS "Fortschritt",
       (n_complete + n_incomplete) || '/' || (n_runs - h.n) AS "Bearbeitet",
       n_complete - n_skipped AS "Neu",
       n_skipped AS "Da",
       n_incomplete AS "Unv.",
       h.n AS "Überg.",
       n_failed_steps AS "Fehler",
       bytes_stored AS "Bronze",
       to_char(last_run AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'DD.MM.YY HH24"Z"') AS "Zuletzt",
       to_char(started_at AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin', 'DD.MM. HH24:MI') AS "Start",
       to_char(finished_at AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin', 'DD.MM. HH24:MI') AS "Ende",
       floor(extract(epoch FROM finished_at - started_at) / 3600)::int || ':' || to_char(finished_at - started_at, 'MI') AS "Dauer",
       CASE WHEN status = 'done' THEN 'fertig' WHEN status = 'failed' THEN 'Fehler'
            WHEN mode = 'live' THEN 'beendet' ELSE 'abgebr.' END AS "Status"
  FROM meta.backfill_job j,
       LATERAL (SELECT count(*) AS n FROM meta.backfill_run r
                 WHERE r.job_id = j.job_id AND r.status = 'handed_over') h
 WHERE status <> 'running'
 ORDER BY finished_at DESC NULLS LAST
 LIMIT 10

SELECT to_char(export_date, 'DD.MM.YY') AS "Export", version AS "Release", CASE status WHEN 'imported' THEN 'importiert' WHEN 'stored' THEN 'gesichert'
            WHEN 'pruned' THEN 'bereinigt' ELSE 'Fehler' END AS "Status",
       n_units AS "Einheiten", size_bytes AS "ZIP",
       to_char(updated_at AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin', 'DD.MM.YY HH24:MI') AS "Stand"
  FROM assets.snapshot ORDER BY export_date DESC

SELECT day::timestamptz AS time, 'Gesamt' AS metric, sum(capacity_mw) / 1000 AS value
  FROM assets.capacity_daily

   AND $__timeFilter(day)

list.name: preis_bis
list.label: Preis-Panel: Länge ab gestern 00:00
list.query:
-- Länge von gestern 00:00 bis Ende heute (vor 12 Uhr) bzw. Ende morgen (ab 12 Uhr), jeweils
-- Europe/Berlin, in ganzen Stunden (timeFrom des Preis-Panels). Unabhängig vom relativen
-- Dashboard-Zeitbereich. Kurze Einheiten sind Pflicht: Grafana verwirft Zeitausdrücke wie
-- "now+262800s-135480s" (Ziffern nach Zeichen 10) und ignoriert dann den timeShift.
-- 'aus' ist ungültig: bei vergangenen/absoluten Zeiträumen nimmt Grafana den Dashboard-Zeitbereich.
WITH b AS (SELECT date_trunc('day', now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin') AS heute,
                  extract(hour FROM now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin') >= 12 AS nachmittag)
SELECT CASE WHEN $__timeTo() >= now() - interval '5 minutes'
            THEN '+' || round(extract(epoch FROM
                   ((heute + CASE WHEN nachmittag THEN interval '2 days' ELSE interval '1 day' END)
                      AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin')
                   - ((heute - interval '1 day') AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin')) / 3600)::bigint || 'h'
            ELSE 'aus' END
  FROM b

list.name: preis_ab
list.label: Preis-Panel: Rückversatz bis gestern 00:00
list.query:
-- Abstand gestern 00:00 (Europe/Berlin) bis jetzt in Minuten, aufgerundet (timeShift des
-- Preis-Panels). Minuten statt Sekunden, siehe preis_bis.
SELECT CASE WHEN $__timeTo() >= now() - interval '5 minutes'
            THEN ceil(extract(epoch FROM now()
                   - ((date_trunc('day', now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin') - interval '1 day')
                        AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin')) / 60)::bigint || 'm'
            ELSE '0m' END
